notes.problem: Subject jammed right, left 60% dead navy, bare cylinders.
notes.fix: Camera left and in, rod and bar on the centre-right vertical, key behind-left for a rim, a pool on the caliche across the lower left.

notes.problem: About 60% of the frame is empty near-black; dim navy jack under a cool fill; plain box carrier bar.
notes.fix: Camera about 1.5 m left and closer so rod, carrier bar and stuffing box fill the centre right; warm west rim on the rod; bevelled bolted carrier bar.

notes.problem: About 60 percent of the frame is dead black; the carrier bar is a plain box; the wellhead is small.
notes.fix: Move the camera left and closer so the rod and stuffing box rise up the centre left under the type, with a work light raking the wellhead from camera left.

notes.problem: Flat white rings read as coins; flat red stands; timber lines.
notes.fix: Three-quarter view so the bodies recede, stagger the ends, I-beam stands with contact.

notes.problem: Tool joints are flat unshaded white rings; pipe bodies smear; the top Texas row floats; timber overshoots.
notes.fix: Bevelled box ends with bore and rim specular, every row seated on a timber cut to stack width, camera about 25 degrees off axis so the bodies run into depth.

notes.problem: 100 pipe ends read as flat white rings at 432 px; the racks sit under a dead band.
notes.fix: Darker joint albedo, bevelled boxes with deep bores raked from the side, camera lower so the racks rise.

notes.problem: Generic document icon in the grey middle, no curl, clip a black box.
notes.fix: Lower rake so tooth and curl cast onto the steel; let the steel outside the pool fall to black.

notes.problem: Even mid-grey page with bar text; curl not visible; the bracketed paragraphs get no more light.
notes.fix: Narrow the key to a near-white pool on the two bracketed paragraphs; lift the curl to cast.

notes.problem: Stock document on a desk, greeked bars.
notes.fix: Re-shoot the page at a low raking view across the steel with a long cast from the curled corner.
Bedding variation and grain; camera closer and lower so the jack stands a quarter of the frame.

notes.problem: Uniform horizontal bump reads as corrugated sheet; the lateral isn't the brightest thing.
notes.fix: Noise-bedded strata, red bed a stop darker, the lateral the one bright specular edge.

notes.problem: The block reads as a slab in a void; leaders end at arbitrary points.
notes.fix: Bleed the block with a lit caliche top to the horizon; land the leaders on the kickoff, heel and toe.

notes.problem: Rods read as barbells; flat tag floating.
notes.fix: Round bodies with a specular line, couplings slightly wider with flats, tag wired to the coupling as lit brass casting onto the plate.

notes.problem: Rectangular rods in two flat tones; flat tag floating clear of the rod.
notes.fix: Cylindrical height profile for bodies and couplings; hang the tag from the coupling so it overlaps and casts.

notes.problem: Cover jack a silhouette with no bright edge.
notes.fix: Key behind-left so the beam top and horsehead curve carry one rim; a low work light on the post and skid.

notes.problem: Apart from the crank the jack is near pure black.
notes.fix: Widen the work light and raise the rim so the beam web and horsehead catch a bright edge.

notes.problem: The jack is an unlit navy silhouette; the kit worker sits under the cite.
notes.fix: A back key at the seam so the beam, horsehead and post catch a rim; move the worker right of the gate post, clear of the cite.
